name: Sarujan
role: Actor · Performer · Dancer · Singer · Content Creator
tagline: Bringing honest characters to life on screen and stage.

paragraphs: I'm Sarujan, an aspiring actor from Sri Lanka with a passion for storytelling, emotion, and bringing characters to life. My journey into acting comes from a love for cinema and the power of expressing real human emotions through performance.

I enjoy exploring different characters and working across films, short-form videos, and creative visual projects. I'm always eager to learn, grow, and take on challenging roles that allow me to push my limits, express creativity, and connect with audiences through authentic performances.
